mapper.select: select * from mall_category where del_flag='0' and category_name like concat('%',#{categoryName},'%') and status=#{status} order by sort_no,category_id
select * from mall_category where category_id=#{categoryId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update mall_category set del_flag='2',update_time=now() where category_id=#{categoryId} and not exists(select 1 from mall_spu where category_id=#{categoryId} and del_flag='0')
mapper.select: select * from mall_brand where del_flag='0' and brand_name like concat('%',#{brandName},'%') and status=#{status} order by sort_no,brand_id
select * from mall_brand where brand_id=#{brandId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update mall_brand set del_flag='2',update_time=now() where brand_id=#{brandId}
mapper.select: select s.*,c.category_name,b.brand_name from mall_spu s join mall_category c on c.category_id=s.category_id left join mall_brand b on b.brand_id=s.brand_id where s.del_flag='0' and s.product_name like concat('%',#{productName},'%') and s.category_id=#{categoryId} and s.brand_id=#{brandId} and s.publish_status=#{publishStatus} order by s.sort_no,s.spu_id desc

select s.*,c.category_name,b.brand_name from mall_spu s join mall_category c on c.category_id=s.category_id left join mall_brand b on b.brand_id=s.brand_id where s.spu_id=#{spuId} and s.del_flag='0' and s.publish_status='1'
mapper.update: update mall_spu set publish_status=#{publishStatus},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=now() where spu_id=#{spuId} and del_flag='0' and (#{publishStatus}='0' or exists(select 1 from mall_sku where spu_id=#{spuId} and status='1' and del_flag='0'))
mapper.select: select s.sku_id,s.spu_id,s.sku_code,s.sku_name,s.spec_json,s.image_url,s.price,s.market_price,coalesce(st.available_quantity,s.available_stock) available_stock,s.status from mall_sku s left join mall_stock st on st.sku_id=s.sku_id where s.spu_id=#{spuId} and s.del_flag='0' order by s.sku_id
mapper.update: update mall_sku set sku_code=#{skuCode},sku_name=#{skuName},spec_json=#{specJson},image_url=#{imageUrl},price=#{price},market_price=#{marketPrice},status=#{status},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=now() where sku_id=#{skuId} and spu_id=#{spuId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select (select count(1) from mall_stock where sku_id=#{skuId} and (locked_quantity>0 or sold_quantity>0)) + (select count(1) from mall_stock_reservation where sku_id=#{skuId} and status in ('LOCKED','CONFIRMED'))
mapper.update: update mall_sku set del_flag='2',update_time=now() where sku_id=#{skuId} and del_flag='0'
update mall_sku set del_flag='2',update_time=now() where spu_id=#{spuId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select * from mall_product_media where spu_id=#{spuId} order by sort_no,media_id
select spec_id specId,category_id categoryId,spec_name specName,sort_no sortNo,status from mall_spec where status='0' and (category_id=#{categoryId} or category_id is null) order by sort_no
select value_id valueId,spec_id specId,value_name valueName,sort_no sortNo from mall_spec_value where spec_id=#{specId} order by sort_no
